title: Special Topics in Black Culture; Black Discourse in Digital Media
description:
Examines the connections between black discourse, oral culture, and traditional media with new digital media technology. Various methods, theoretical approaches, and tools for studying social media and online communication.

Crosslisted with COMM498A. Credit only granted for COMM498A or AASP498Q.

Satisfies elective requirements for the Digital Studies in the Arts and Humanities (DSAH) graduate certificate.
